People who believe in a flat Earth assume that gravity would pull straight down , but there ’ s no evidence to suggest it would work that way . What we know about gravity suggest it would pull toward the center of the disk . That mean it would only pull straight down at one point on the center of the disk . As you get increasingly far from the center , gravity would tug more and more horizontally . A basic fact of modern American lawmaking at the federal level be that most bill can only pass if they have 60 or more vote in the Senate—unless the bill be subject to special procedure . Without 60 vote , any senator can block most bill use a procedure know a the filibuster . But with the country persistently split along party line , today there be often a vast , unbridgeable divide between the 51st and 60th vote in the Senate . Constitution make no mention of the filibuster , it also appear to assume that legislative decision would be make by majority vote . Until 1806 , a Senate rule allow a simple majority to end debate on a bill and move to a vote . 6 The term filibuster enter use even later , in the 1850s , when it describe the practice of senator give lengthy speech to delay a vote on a bill . While member of stand committee be formally designate by Senate resolution , member of select and special committee be officially appoint by the Senate 's president or president pro tempore . In early year , both house of Congress use joint committee more extensively than they do today for purpose of legislative and administrative coordination .
